name: cli-hub-matrix-video-creation
description: Capability-based multi-tool matrix for video production. Agents pick providers (CLI-Anything harnesses, public CLIs, Python libs, native binaries, cloud APIs) per capability rather than marching through fixed stages, including storyboard planning, story/audio direction, source triage, internet video/music search/download, capture/generation, analysis, sound design, high-end caption design, NLE/render doctor investigation, review, and packaging.
